Name: lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for SVE
Author: lunakatt
Description:
[center][size=4]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for SVE[/size]

This mod is intended as an extension to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url]﻿ for the characters from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿. This version is only high res portraits. [/center]


[size=3]Content Patcher Version[/size]

Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]

Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the CP version of this mod into your mods directory
3. Run the game using SMAPI

[left]-----[/left]
[size=3]Portraiture Mod Version[/size]

Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]

Install instructions:
1. Install required mods listed
2. To work alongside DCBurger's portrait mod, place all of the PNG files in the same folder you put DCBurger's portraits into
3. Run the game using SMAPI, and press 'P' during a conversation to show the portraits

-----

[b]Please note[/b] that the CP version of this mod currently does not show shop/vendor portraits but Claire and Martin's in-conversation portraits will change on location change (e.g. when Claire enters JojaMart she will change into her Joja uniform), and the Portraiture version of this mod is the opposite, so shop/vendor portraits will show but Claire and Martin won't change into their Joja or Theatre clothing.


[size=4][b]Go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url]﻿ to get the updated portraits of Gunther, Magnus, Marlon, and Morris! [/b][/size]
[list]
[*]For the CP version drop them into  '[CP] lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for SVE/assets'.
[*]For the Portraiture version drop them into the same Portraits folder alongside DCBurger's and mine's other PNGs.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13599?tab=description]HD Portraits Patches for PyTK[/url] by purplexpresso to get a patch for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] :D
[/size][/b]Thank you to purplexpresso, go show them some love on their mod page!

Special thanks to DCBurger for both their permission to work on this mod and for all their help!
Thanks also to the people in my discord server who helped me test this mod! :D


If you'd like, consider buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lunakatt]Ko-fi[/url]!
